cases.prompt: Which court exercises appellate jurisdiction over court-martial convictions under the Army Act 1950?
cases.expected_answer: Armed Forces Tribunal (AFT)
cases.statutory_authority: Armed Forces Tribunal Act, 2007 (Section 15)

cases.prompt: Is the judgment in ADM Jabalpur v. Shivkant Shukla (AIR 1976 SC 1207) currently good law in India?
cases.expected_answer: No, it was expressly overruled by a 9-judge Constitution bench in K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India (2017).
cases.statutory_authority: Articles 21 and 141; Puttaswamy (2017) 10 SCC 1

cases.prompt: Can a 2-judge Division Bench of the Supreme Court overrule a 5-judge Constitution Bench?
cases.expected_answer: No. Under Article 141 and established precedent hierarchy, a bench can only be overruled by a bench of larger numerical strength.
cases.statutory_authority: Union of India v. Raghubir Singh (1989) 2 SCC 754

cases.prompt: What official legislative enactment was directly formulated in response to the Supreme Court's guidelines in Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan (1997)?
cases.expected_answer: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
cases.statutory_authority: Statement of Objects and Reasons, POSH Act 2013

cases.prompt: Under what statutory provisions is it prohibited to publish the name or identity of a rape survivor in India?
cases.expected_answer: Section 228A of the Indian Penal Code 1860 and Section 72 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023.
cases.statutory_authority: Section 228A IPC / Section 72 BNS 2023; Nipun Saxena v. Union of India (2019)

cases.prompt: What is the current status of Suresh Kumar Koushal v. Naz Foundation (2014)?
cases.expected_answer: Overruled by a 5-judge bench in Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India (2018).
cases.statutory_authority: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India (2018) 1 SCC 791

cases.prompt: What is the current status of Sowmithri Vishnu v. Union of India (1985)?
cases.expected_answer: Overruled by a 5-judge Constitution Bench in Joseph Shine v. Union of India (2018).
cases.statutory_authority: Joseph Shine v. Union of India (2018) 2 SCC 189

cases.prompt: What happened to Section 66A of the Information Technology Act 2000 after the Supreme Court decision in Shreya Singhal (2015)?
cases.expected_answer: Section 66A was struck down in its entirety as unconstitutional for violating Article 19(1)(a).
cases.statutory_authority: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India (2015) 5 SCC 1

cases.prompt: What was the highest judicial tribunal for British Indian appeals prior to 1949?
cases.expected_answer: Judicial Committee of the Privy Council (abolished by Abolition of Privy Council Jurisdiction Act, 1949).
cases.statutory_authority: Abolition of Privy Council Jurisdiction Act 1949

cases.prompt: Between 1937 and 1950, which court functioned as the predecessor to the Supreme Court of India?
cases.expected_answer: Federal Court of India
cases.statutory_authority: Government of India Act 1935, Part IX

cases.prompt: What does the citation format '2023 INSC 101' represent?
cases.expected_answer: The official Neutral Citation for the Supreme Court of India, judgment number 101 of year 2023.
cases.statutory_authority: Supreme Court of India Neutral Citation System Circular (2023)

cases.prompt: What does the citation format '2023:DHC:1234' represent?
cases.expected_answer: The official Neutral Citation for the High Court of Delhi, judgment number 1234 of year 2023.
cases.statutory_authority: High Court of Delhi Neutral Citation Guidelines

cases.prompt: Under which constitutional article do High Courts exercise administrative superintendence over District Courts?
cases.expected_answer: Article 227 of the Constitution of India.
cases.statutory_authority: Article 227, Constitution of India

cases.prompt: Which tribunal hears statutory appeals from orders of the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT)?
cases.expected_answer: National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT)
cases.statutory_authority: Companies Act 2013 (Section 410) & IBC 2016 (Section 61)

cases.prompt: What is the principal forum for statutory disputes under the National Green Tribunal Act 2010?
cases.expected_answer: National Green Tribunal (NGT)
cases.statutory_authority: National Green Tribunal Act, 2010

cases.prompt: Which amendments to the CrPC codified the arrest guidelines issued in D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal (1997)?
cases.expected_answer: Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Act, 2008 (inserting Sections 41A, 41B, 41C, and 41D).
cases.statutory_authority: CrPC (Amendment) Act 2008 (Act 5 of 2009)

cases.prompt: Does the POCSO Act 2012 permit disclosing a child victim's school name or photograph in case reports?
cases.expected_answer: No, Section 74 of the POCSO Act strictly prohibits disclosing the child's school, address, or photograph.
cases.statutory_authority: POCSO Act 2012, Section 74

cases.prompt: Was Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973) overruled by any subsequent bench?
cases.expected_answer: No, it remains good law and forms the bedrock of the Basic Structure Doctrine in Indian Constitutional Law.
cases.statutory_authority: Minerva Mills (1980) 3 SCC 625; I.R. Coelho (2007) 2 SCC 1

cases.prompt: In LegalMitra's 11-tier coverage framework, what does Tier 1 designate?
cases.expected_answer: Catalogued: The institution's identity, jurisdiction, and historical predecessor are catalogued, but records are not yet ingested.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra Tier Framework (Tier 0 to Tier 10)

cases.prompt: In LegalMitra's 11-tier coverage framework, what does Tier 5 designate?
cases.expected_answer: Sampling Validated: A representative sample of judgments is ingested, OCR quality audited, and metadata verified.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra Tier Framework

cases.prompt: Under which substantive domain does a petition challenging an environmental clearance under the NGT Act fall?
cases.expected_answer: ENVIRONMENTAL_FOREST
cases.statutory_authority: National Green Tribunal Act 2010

cases.prompt: Under which substantive domain does an application under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016 fall?
cases.expected_answer: COMMERCIAL_CORPORATE_INSOLVENCY
cases.statutory_authority: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016

cases.prompt: Which High Courts were the earliest established under the Indian High Courts Act 1861?
cases.expected_answer: Calcutta High Court (July 1862), Bombay High Court (August 1862), and Madras High Court (August 1862).
cases.statutory_authority: Indian High Courts Act 1861 (24 & 25 Vict. c. 104)

cases.prompt: Can a legislative change be classified as a direct response to a judgment if only temporal sequence is known?
cases.expected_answer: No. Under LegalMitra's evidentiary standard, it must be classified as MERE_TEMPORAL_SEQUENCE unless official documents (SOR, debates, Law Commission) establish causation.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra Evidentiary Standards

cases.prompt: Are decisions of the Armed Forces Tribunal subject to writ jurisdiction of High Courts under Article 226?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, a 5-judge bench in Union of India v. Parashotam Dass (2023) held that High Courts can exercise supervisory jurisdiction under Article 226 over AFT orders.
cases.statutory_authority: Union of India v. Parashotam Dass, 2023 INSC 261
